measurement: One sequential pass. First request per dataset opens a new inference connection; provider warmth is unknown. Timings are client EDIT_INFER to SQL and SQL execution, not rendering or photons. Database result cache, rollups and compression disabled. No speculative requests.

base.originalQuestion: Daily average temperature in Berlin during 2024
base.sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS day, avg(temperature) AS temperature FROM weather WHERE city = 'Berlin' AND time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

history.text: Daily average temperature in Berlin during 2024

cases.request: Use the maximum instead of the average. For the time bucket, use day as a bare alias, without AS and without quotes: date_trunc('day', time) day.
cases.reference: SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS day, max(temperature) AS temperature FROM weather WHERE city = 'Berlin' AND time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
